card.name: Grade and age labels in book listings
card.fires_on: Words and symbols in children's book or app listings that introduce a grade or age range, such as Grade, Gr, ages, or Appropriate for. It fires just before the reading level or age numbers.

modes.label: Grade level labels
modes.description: Grade or Gr in a book review or catalog entry, right before the grade numbers.

modes.label: Age range cues
modes.description: The space, number or wording just before an age range for children.
modes.example: Appropriate for children ages<< >>5 to 8 years.

modes.label: Audience labels
modes.description: Words naming a young readership, such as Young before Adults in a reading list.
modes.example: Best Books for<< Young>> Adults - http://www.ala.org

card.writes: It pushes toward theme and audience words such as themes, thematic and adult.
card.plain: It spots the place in a children's book or app listing where a grade or age range is given.
evidence: Appropriate for children ages<< >>5 to 8 years.
